lines.text: The psalmist loves God's law, meditates on it all day, and says it makes him wiser than his enemies.
God's words are sweeter than figs in his mouth, and he hates every false way.
God's word is a lamp to his feet and a light to his path.
The wicked set a snare, yet he has not strayed, and he calls the LORD his hiding place and fortress.
The LORD discards all the wicked on earth like dross, and the psalmist's flesh trembles in awe of Him.
